description: Lists roads and paths, buildings, areas, or ground regions of the design with a ready-to-insert request fragment and its target path; a building also carries the placement of a custom house that replaces it.

class.description: Feature class such as highway.residential, or a prefix such as highway.

design.description: Complete design (MapRequest) as create_design returns it; the full JSON schema is the resource neuronform://schema/design and get_design_guide explains every section.

lang.description: Language of the summaries and error messages; default en.

near.description: Orders the elements by distance from this point.
